# Programmatic SEO

`aaj-programmatic-seo` · v1.0.1 · Design · SEO, GEO & AEO
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/aaj-programmatic-seo/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Will a template-page build pay back, and how many of the pages we build will actually earn traffic?

**Inputs:** The dataset or head-term × modifier pattern, expected page count and query volume, conversion rate and value per conversion, build cost, and what unique data exists per page

**Output:** A viability verdict with the indexation/ranking funnel and payback, the template spec, the per-page uniqueness requirement, internal-linking and indexation plan, and a staged rollout

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill aaj-programmatic-seo`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/aaj-programmatic-seo/resources/pseo-model.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/aaj-programmatic-seo/resources/pseo-model.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- The default 60% indexation and 30% page-one rates are AAJ assumptions chosen to be sobering, not measured rates. Replace them with your 50-page pilot or Search Console numbers.
- The CTR curve predates AI Overviews and the AI Overview drag is an AAJ assumption, so click projections for informational queries are uncertain.
- It takes query volume as given. Keyword tools round up long-tail volume, so treat estimates under 50 as directional and pull real volume for a sample of pages.
- A good payback does not make the pages safe to build. It takes your unique-data rating on trust and can't see whether pages are linked, crawlable or doorway pages.

**Review before acting:** The SEO or content lead checks the volume sample and the unique-data rating, and the founder confirms conversion rate, value per conversion and build cost. Re-run with observed rates after a 50-page pilot before building the full set.
